task: Represent checker-authorized copies emitted into specialized native function bodies in clone provenance.
observation: The production provenance builder required one helper definition globally for each checked copy fact. Regex emitted the same source fact once in each concrete and borrowed-view generated body, so the valid second body failed the global uniqueness check. Binding each explicit clone to its exact tooling function marker, generated symbol, function span, and body hash distinguishes static variants while retaining one checked source fact.
impact: The focused builder and production-sidecar audit accept the same fact across distinct callable-matching variants and reject same-variant duplicates, unrelated callable claims, and forged variant identity, symbol, and span. With the absolute isolated compiler path, Regex passes Moss checking and writes Rust plus the sidecar; Cargo then reports 20 native Rust type errors assigned to Team B.

resolution.summary: Builder and sidecar gates pass locally; independent fixup review and Regex native compilation remain pending.

task: Independently bind generated callable symbols in v3 clone sidecars to checked Program authority.
observation: A coordinated tamper changed the raw tooling marker, Rust declaration, sidecar symbol list, function-variant hash, and Rust digest together; the audit still accepted an explicit-copy clone when checked symbols were read only from that same sidecar. The checker copy-authority query now returns sorted per-context callable projections outside canonical TypedCopyFact rows, and the auditor requires exact equality. A second holdout found ordinary function source contexts with location suffixes and empty Function.source_file metadata; normalization plus checked Program/context/module matching supports these while rejecting the coordinated forgery.
impact: The live oracle now rejects the coordinated marker/declaration/sidecar forgery as INVALID_PROVENANCE and accepts a non-main function copy through production generation and audit. TypedCopyFact identity digests remain unchanged.
